explanations.3: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive tells the package installer not to ask interactive questions, which would hang the build process.
explanations.9: Deleting the apt cache files after install saves space in the final image since we won't need to reinstall those packages.
explanations.12: The printf command with multiple quoted strings concatenates them together—each '%s\n' becomes one line when written to the file.
explanations.31: The $'...' syntax lets you use escape sequences like \e for color codes; the \'\' is how you embed a literal single quote inside this special string.
explanations.42: unalias removes any existing alias named 'gst' before defining our function, so older definitions won't interfere.
explanations.53: The >> operator appends all those printf lines to the end of the .zshrc file rather than overwriting it.
explanations.63: GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE environment variables let you fake when commits were made, so this demo has commits from different dates.
explanations.88: The -i flag makes the shell interactive and -l makes it a login shell, both needed for .zshrc to actually run when the container starts.
